text.p: Noranda Inc Chief Executive David Kerr forecast on Thursday that Noranda's 1997 capital spending would rise to C$2.2 billion from C$1.7 billion last year.

Kerr said in a prepared speech to the annual meeting that the company's strong cash flow had helped it maintain a conservative debt profile. He said Noranda could benefit from increasing the amount of debt on its balance sheet.
"So in 1997, we are going to do something about that. Specifically, we are going to be increasing our capital expenditures to a forecast level of C$2.2 billion," Kerr said.
He said that would be record capital spending for the natural resources company.
